threadDescriptions.court-resurfacing: Plan and verify resurfacing of the badminton club's damaged court
threadDescriptions.family-open-day: Organize a family badminton introduction event
threadDescriptions.membership-trial: Evaluate and administer the club's four-visit trial membership offer
threadDescriptions.lost-equipment: Return unclaimed personal equipment from the badminton hall
threadDescriptions.balcony-door: Repair the sticking balcony door at home

items.text: Court two surface lifting near the baseline. Contractor estimates a one-day closure next Monday for patching and recoating.
Family badminton day: short taster games, loan racquets, quiet corner for introductions. Advertise Sunday morning with a capped signup list.
Trial club offer draft: four visits for 18, valid six weeks from first use. Track conversions to full membership after the final visit.

At family day registration, issue each interested household the four-visit trial card and enter its first-use date in the membership tracker. Add a ten-minute trial-offer explanation to the event welcome so families understand the expiry.
items.rationale: Integrates event agenda with trial administration.

items.text: Balcony door drags on the lower corner when closed. Mark the rub point with chalk and inspect the hinge screws.
Unclaimed hall box: green junior racquet, two water bottles, one shoe bag. Photograph items without showing names on the bottles.
Court contractor revised the closure to three days: coating needs longer to cure. Replace Monday-only notice with Monday through Wednesday and block those bookings.
Green one, four, next week
Family day has 23 signups, including eight children. Split beginner games across both available courts and assign an adult helper to each group.
Trial card ledger: six households started, one has used all four visits. Ask that household whether booking times met their needs before counting a conversion.
Racquet claimant can describe the grip repair under the green tape. Arrange collection of that junior racquet after verifying it matches.
Balcony upper hinge screws were loose. Tightened them; door clears the frame but still needs a pull to latch.
Could move it to Wednesday if she agrees.
items.rationale: No identified event, item, or person.

items.text: Court two after curing: baseline patch flush, but one edge line is uneven. Contractor to repaint that short section before reopening.
Family day welcome sign should say loan racquets available and show where the quiet introduction corner is. Use large type at the entrance.
Four-visit trial feedback: evening slots too scarce for two families. Summarize this constraint in the trial review before proposing a permanent offer.
Junior racquet collected by its owner; shoe bag remains unclaimed. Update the hall lost-property photo so members stop asking about the racquet.
Latch plate moved slightly on the balcony door. It now closes without pulling; test again when the afternoon sun warms the frame.
Photo is too blurred to see whether that's the mark we meant.
Court two reopened after the line repaint and slip check. Remove the closure notice and retain the contractor's three-day curing record.
